limitations: The render is an industrial-design concept, not a fabrication package.
Visual features indicate design intent only and do not establish performance.
No patentability, safety, manufacturability, certification, or commercial-readiness conclusion is supported.
claim_boundary: This receipt proves repository custody, SHA-256 identity, and declared V2-to-V3 concept lineage for the listed public artifacts. It does not prove CAD completeness, electrical or thermal performance, energy density, cycle life, crashworthiness, prototype status, safety certification, patentability, manufacturability, field validation, or commercial readiness.
